title: How Are You Distributing Your AI Games?
author: bingewavecinema
selftext: What platforms are you distributing on? Do you have a marketing strategy? Do you hope to make any money or just for fun?

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body:
hey there! 

  
I currently in between a monstrous case load and other projects, try to market them on Reddit where I can but usually end up getting banned from sub reddits or IMMEDIATE hate when anything ***AI***  is mentioned. I would suggest try marketing it on Tiktok or IG or YouTube Shorts where you would find a more objective audience who aren't all pessimist

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: use for finding subbeddits to post in: [https://www.glitch.fun/publishers/reddit-community-finder](https://www.glitch.fun/publishers/reddit-community-finder)

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: Yeah Im just super nervous everytime bc people are usually negative

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: If there is no requirement to disclose its made with AI, when why do it?

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: I don’t want to come across like I’m hiding it and try to be upfront

comments.author: Even-Potential-8064
comments.body: I'm going to try Poki and CrazyGames. I've had a couple games on Poki but now we have to go through testing before a game can go live, so I'm not sure how it will go

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: What is the process, cost and revenue to post on those sites?

replies.author: Even-Potential-8064
replies.body:
CrazyGames is free to create an account, then you can test your games.   
Poki is similar but you have to apply to get an account.  
Then you need to test your games and if they pass all the tests the game gets published.  
If your games fail the tests you get nothing, if they just barely pass you'll probably get some money but nothing crazy, and if it's a hit game you might get some serious money. I've made a little bit of side money on Poki years ago but nothing worth bragging about...

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: I too aim for CrazyGames, I feel like they have a good community of gamers

comments.author: PhotojournalistBig53
comments.body:
1k sales is my perhaps unrealistic goal but I’m doing a pretty ambitious project. Been at it for half a year now and will probably be another year before it’s done. 

Tried Reddit but got immediately curb stomped by ai haters who didn’t even look at my game so that’s a non starter and tbh it’s not worth shit. TikTok/ig/YT-shorts will get you 700-1k non viral eyes per post, no hate (yet..). 

I don’t do a lot of marketing though. I only show and maybe milk a little everything I have something finished to show. Not doing devlogs or anything like that as I have to dedicate most of my time to making the game.

replies.author: PhotojournalistBig53
replies.body: It’s called Driftbane, the long awaited.  3d isometric party based strategy rpg. You can check it out on Steam or YouTube.

replies.author: bledviolet
replies.body: Is a lot of the art placeholder?

replies.author: PhotojournalistBig53
replies.body: Yup. Alpha rather. Redoing all the models, vfx and sfx for the demo that should launch around September. Will probably redo it again in October/nov.

comments.author: Some-Ice-4455
comments.body: I used steam for my AI app. The trade-off for their fees was worth it imo..
